reviews.title: Human art missing
reviews.text:
Spotify has for years excelled at reading music tastes and suggesting novel new artists; however, I have repeatedly been tricked into listening to AI-generated songs that have lead me to question any and all suggested music. I understood that for years Spotify developed a clever, almost intelligent algorithm to personalize our suggestions, but when that machine suggests machine-made music that feels messed up. I listen to music to feel a connection with other humans. Instead, this former collection of curated creativity has begun to rot. I eagerly await any alternative to this app or at the very least an option to avoid AI-generated content.

Do users crave generic, generative sound or do you crave royalty-free content?

reviews.title: Spotify
reviews.text: Been using spotify for years now, always had premium, it works great enough but the new ai dj stuff is pretty redundant when songs based on the current one playing are added with the radio function, which seems to be slowly pushed away and hidden in favor of the aforementioned ai slop, also having said ive always had premium its quite annoying to keep getting ads asking me to upgrade my plan to duo or family id rather it didnt do that.

reviews.title: The amount of ads pisses me off
reviews.text: So I love this app. I love listening to music. I feel like Spotify is the best app I can do that with. But the ads. Oh the ads. I get 4-5 ads for every like maybe 2 songs I listen to. Which is the worst thing ever. It’s worse when I want to listen to peaceful music but then loud bs blares in my ears because all I wanted to do was zone out. They used to give us 30 minute ad breaks. Where on earth did that go? If people don’t want to pay for a subscription they shouldn’t be punished for not having said subscription.
